newsitem.title: FRANCE: Aero cargo appointed French GSA for Uzbekistan Air.
newsitem.headline: Aero cargo appointed French GSA for Uzbekistan Air.

text.p: Aero Cargo International said it had been appointed French cargo sales agent for Uzbekistan Airways, effective January 15.
"The airline launched a weekly full-freighter service between Ostend and Taskhent last December using an Ilyushin 76," an Aero Cargo official told Reuters.
"Our objective is to generate around ten tonnes of freight per week for the Ostend-Tashkent service, shipments being trucked from Paris and largely made up of industrial goods," he added.
Aero Cargo is French GSA for several airlines including Aeromexico, Asiana, Austrian Airlines, British Midland and Kenya Airways.
